title: First Day Paid in a Month of Training - Flat Monthly Benefit Schedule Note
content:
**Schedule note — Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education), flat monthly benefit of Chapter 30, Chapter 35 and Chapter 1606.**

The days paid for a month count from the first day paid, which follows the resident certification — the latest certification on the benefit whose courses are not all distance learning:

- when its term starts after the first day of the month and within it (on the second through the thirtieth day), the days paid begin on the term start;
- when its term started earlier and a school correction of the benefit took effect after the first day of the month, the days paid begin on that correction's effective date — the effective date of the latest school correction reported on the benefit;
- otherwise they begin on the first day of the month.

The first day paid is itself a day paid; the days run from it through the last day payable with both ends counted.

| Resident term start | School correction on the benefit | First day paid (month of April) |
|---|---|---|
| April 6 | — | April 6 |
| March 2 | Effective April 11 | April 11 |
| March 2 | Effective April 1 | April 1 |
| March 2 | None | April 1 |

**Hypothetical days count.** With the month's last payable day on the thirtieth: first day paid April 6 gives 25 days; April 11 gives 20 days; April 1 gives 30 days.
